sub: KP trophy hunt auction top bid hits
paragraphs: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa ne markhor trophy hunting ke **4 permits** auction kiye. Kul boli **$1,211,800** (taqreeban **Rs 33.57 crore**) rahi.
Sab se oonchi boli Chitral ke **Toshi-II** area ke liye **$335,600** lagi. Pichle saal top boli **$272,000** thi.
Baqi permits Toshi-I, Kaigah Khwar aur Gehrait Gol ke liye bike, jo Chitral aur Kohistan mein hain.
Is raqam ka **80%** maqami abadi ki behbood aur janwaron ke tahaffuz par lagega, aur **20%** sarkari khazane mein jayega.
question: Kya aap is tareeqe ko sahi samajhte hain?
